scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @discordy/core lint && pnpm --filter @discordy/desktop lint && pnpm --filter @discordy/mobile lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @discordy/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @discordy/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @discordy/mobile typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @discordy/core test && pnpm --filter @discordy/desktop test && pnpm --filter @discordy/mobile test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test:unit && pnpm --filter @discordy/desktop exec electron-vite build && node apps/desktop/scripts/check-renderer-budget.mjs
